name: Personal Project Game - Idan Aviv
author: MentalSpartan
description: I created this game in the hopes of incorporating a new and innovative way of learning. As is evident through the widespread success of videogames as a whole, the field is growing at an incredibly fast pace. With math being seen as one of the hardest subjects at school, I took it upon myself to create a mathematics teaching tool (to help students). This game is aimed at a grade 6 level, incorporating some notable topics from their units such as, decimals, percentages, algebra, etc... I hope that this teaching tool proves to be effective, and as they say... Flap Away!
